title: RWB-S9-E7018-APP: no source owns the field visit or its evidence in S9, publishes a field-collector role, a result-code list, a document, interaction or rule operation name, an interface ID for the field app or a refusal message for a closed instruction, no partner route set exists, and TSD S9 T8 maps REQ-S9-009 to another feature
source: Template and Rules v1 R3, R4, R5.4, R5.5, R5.7, R7.2, R7.3 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S9-E7018-APP; context pack S9 rwb-partner (service row, ownership rows: tables partner, partner_instruction and partner_user, 6 REST operations, EV-20 and EV-21, workflow InstructionWorkflow, no job; Architecture v5 slides 2, 4, 5, 8 and 12); legacy RWB-E7-018; FSD S9 Partner management v3 A1.2, A1.3, A2.15, A2.15.2, A2.15.3.1 to A2.15.3.3, A2.15.4, the Screens table and Requirements served; TSD S9 Partner management v2 T1, T2, T3.0, T3.1, T3.2, T3.3, T4, T5.1, T5.2, T5.3, T6.1, T6.2, T8 and T-A; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 Rules sheet; LDM and Data Dictionary v8 partner_user, interaction, LOV-CHANNEL, LOV-CONTACT-SRC and LOV-ROLE; Event and Messaging Design v4 event EV-21; Program BRD v4 rows REQ-S9-009, REQ-DCM-013, NFR-062 and NFR-063; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-PRM-15
description: (1) The legacy feature records visits, photographs and bills against the case, but no table in S9 holds a visit or evidence: the ownership rows give the service partner, partner_instruction, partner_user, and TSD S9 T3.1 defines the first two only, while the LDM v8 puts a visit in interaction of P1 (DF-INT-001 to DF-INT-013, LOV-CHANNEL VISIT, LOV-CONTACT-SRC FIELD_VISIT) and a photograph or a bill in document of P5 (REQ-DCM-013), so both are read as other services' rows with no operation name published (ASM-B2-S9-016-1, ASM-B2-S9-016-3). (2) The field collector is the primary role of the feature in FSD S9 A2.15.3.3 and no such role exists in TSD S9 T6.1; partner_user.role_code reads LOV-ROLE, which publishes no list, and API-S9-005 declares partner portal right U for 13 identities, so the role code a field collector holds is unknown (ASM-B2-S9-016-2). (3) partner_instruction.result_code (DF-PRT-015) is a free varchar(40) with no list, so the result vocabulary the field app must send has no source (ASM-B2-S9-016-4). (4) No partner route set exists in the Business Rules and Routing Logic v4: the nearest rows are R-UNI-38, R-UNI-39 and R-UNI-40, and none names a visit or a result, so the rule ID and the version the decision record must carry have no row (ASM-B2-S9-016-6). (5) The legacy screen states of PRT-02 (New, accepted, in progress, result, closed) do not match LOV-INSTR-STATUS (SENT, ACCEPTED, DECLINED, IN_PROGRESS, DONE, RECALLED), and DECLINED and RECALLED have no screen state (ASM-B2-S9-016-7). (6) The field app has no interface ID: TSD S9 T5.1 names INT-24 only, the field app is not an INT, and NFR-062 (offline capture) and NFR-063 (partner devices) are Proposed under DL11 with no target value and no media type or size limit for an upload (ASM-B2-S9-016-11). (7) TSD S9 T8 maps REQ-S9-009 to FEAT-PRM-08 while the requirement text is field work and the FSD lists it under FEAT-PRM-15 (ASM-B2-S9-016-8). (8) The plan's C row is empty while three consumed rows are declared, and DP-18, DP-05 and DP-09 are absent from the pattern set of the key (ASM-B2-S9-016-1, ASM-B2-S9-016-3, ASM-B2-S9-016-5). (9) EV-21 PartnerResultSubmitted is published in TSD S9 T5.3 and consumed in the event catalogue (ASM-B2-S9-016-5). (10) The refusal of an instruction that is DONE, DECLINED or RECALLED has no message in any source (ASM-B2-S9-016-10).
evidence: TSD S9 T3.1 (partner and partner_instruction only, no visit and no evidence column), T3.2 (LOV-INSTR-STATUS, LOV-INSTRUCTION, LOV-PANEL, LOV-PARTNER-TYPE and no result list), T5.1 (INT-24 only), T5.2 (documents through P5, notices through P6), T5.3 (InstructionIssued and PartnerResultSubmitted), T6.1 (29 identities, no field collector), T6.2, T8 (REQ-S9-009 mapped to FEAT-PRM-08) and T-A.2 (API-S9-005 multipart result and files, errors 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 503); FSD S9 A1.2 row FEAT-PRM-15, A2.15.2 (integration points: field app, the Workbench document hub), A2.15.3.1 (VR-S9-015-1 and BR-S9-015 only), A2.15.3.2 (eight partner fields, no visit and no evidence), A2.15.3.3 (field collector primary), A2.15.4.4 (no background event), the Screens table (PRT-02 five states) and Requirements served (REQ-S9-009); LDM v8 partner_user DF-REF-212 to DF-REF-217 and LOV-ROLE, interaction DF-INT-001 to DF-INT-013, LOV-CHANNEL VISIT and LOV-CONTACT-SRC FIELD_VISIT; Program BRD v4 REQ-S9-009, REQ-DCM-013, NFR-062 and NFR-063; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 Rules sheet (no R-PRM rows; R-UNI-38 to R-UNI-40 nearest); Event and Messaging Design v4 EV-21 and the Events sheet note; legacy RWB-E7-018 Data, Endpoints, Screen and states, Permission checks and Validation and messages tables
owner_role: Business lead; solution architect; rwb-document owner; rwb-source-data owner; rwb-decision rule owner; rwb-access role owner
proposed: Read the visit as a rwb-source-data interaction entry and the photographs and bills as rwb-document claims requested on their contracts with fakes, keep the result on partner_instruction.result_code with status DONE, submit on API-S9-005 with the Idempotency-Key, write the local decision record before any change with the rule ID and the version where they exist and the placeholder where they do not, carry the field-collector role, the result vocabulary, the PRT-02 state mapping, the field-app interface and its non-functional targets, and the requirement mis-mapping as open items with placeholder text.

title: RWB-S9-E7018-CON: the contract has no field-work, evidence, result-vocabulary, media-type or document-reference source, partner_user publishes no role list, the plan's C row is empty while three consumed rows are declared, DP-05, DP-09 and DP-18 are absent, the element overlaps the baseline of RWB-S9-E6033-CON, EV-21 has two directions, the field app has no interface ID, and TSD S9 T8 maps REQ-S9-009 to another feature
source: Template and Rules v1 R3, R4, R5.4, R5.5, R5.7, R7.2, R7.3 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S9-E7018-CON; context pack S9 rwb-partner (service row, ownership rows, Architecture v5 slides 2, 4, 5, 8 and 12); legacy RWB-E7-018; FSD S9 Partner management v3 A1.2, A2.15.2, A2.15.3.1 to A2.15.3.3, A2.15.4, the Screens table and Requirements served; TSD S9 Partner management v2 T2, T3.0, T3.1, T3.2, T3.3, T4, T5.1, T5.2, T5.3, T6.1, T6.2, T8 and T-A.1 to T-A.2; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 Rules sheet; LDM and Data Dictionary v8; Event and Messaging Design v4; Program BRD v4 rows REQ-S9-009, REQ-DCM-013, NFR-062 and NFR-063; the sibling baseline RWB S9 E6033 CON Capture field work through the field app - contract v1
description: (1) TSD S9 T-A.1 and T-A.2 publish API-S9-005 with its access, its multipart request, its PartnerInstruction answer and its errors 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422 and 503, but no source publishes a field-work element, a document reference, a visit reference, a media type, a size limit or a result-code list, so each carries the placeholder (ASM-B2-S9-016-1, ASM-B2-S9-016-4, ASM-B2-S9-016-12). (2) The visit is P1's interaction and the evidence is P5's document (REQ-DCM-013), and neither publishes an operation name, so the two consumed rows of the baseline are declared with a fake and a placeholder (ASM-B2-S9-016-1, ASM-B2-S9-016-3). (3) partner_user binds one identity to one firm and one role (DF-REF-212 to DF-REF-217) and role_code reads LOV-ROLE, which publishes no list, so no partner-identity element can declare a role enumeration (ASM-B2-S9-016-2). (4) The Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 has no R-PRM route set, so the rule ID and the version of the decision-record element have no row, no package and no set (ASM-B2-S9-016-6). (5) The plan's C row is None while the baseline declares three consumed rows, and DP-05, DP-09 and DP-18 are absent from the pattern set of the key (ASM-B2-S9-016-1, ASM-B2-S9-016-3, ASM-B2-S9-016-5). (6) The result operation is already baselined by RWB-S9-E6033-CON for the portal intake, so this baseline adds one element inside that baseline and must not re-declare a path, an operation ID or an existing property (ASM-B2-S9-016-12). (7) Event and Messaging Design v4 reads EV-21 as consumed and TSD S9 T5.3 lists it as published (ASM-B2-S9-016-5). (8) The field app has no interface ID in TSD S9 T5.1 and NFR-062 and NFR-063 are Proposed under DL11 (ASM-B2-S9-016-11). (9) TSD S9 T8 maps REQ-S9-009 to FEAT-PRM-08 while the requirement text is field work (ASM-B2-S9-016-8). (10) The 409 of a closed instruction has no message in any source (ASM-B2-S9-016-10).
evidence: TSD S9 T-A.1 (six operations with access and first-in), T-A.2 (API-S9-005 multipart request, PartnerInstruction answer, errors 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 503, Idempotency-Key), T3.1 (partner and partner_instruction only), T3.2 (four lists, no result list), T5.1 (INT-24 only), T5.2 (documents through P5), T5.3 (InstructionIssued and PartnerResultSubmitted published), T6.1 (29 identities and their rights, no field collector), T8 (REQ-S9-009 mapped to FEAT-PRM-08); FSD S9 A2.15.2 (integration points: field app, the Workbench document hub), A2.15.3.2 (eight partner fields), A2.15.3.3 (field collector primary) and the Screens table; LDM v8 partner_user DF-REF-212 to DF-REF-217 and LOV-ROLE, interaction DF-INT-001 to DF-INT-013 and LOV-CONTACT-SRC FIELD_VISIT; Program BRD v4 REQ-S9-009, REQ-DCM-013, NFR-062 and NFR-063; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 Rules sheet (no R-PRM rows; R-UNI-38 to R-UNI-40 nearest); Event and Messaging Design v4 EV-21 and the Events sheet note; legacy RWB-E7-018 Endpoints, Data and Validation tables; split plan slice RWB-S9-E7018-CON (C empty)
owner_role: Solution architect; rwb-partner tech lead; business lead; rwb-document owner; rwb-source-data owner; rwb-decision rule owner; rwb-access role owner
proposed: Add one FieldWorkResult element inside the published baseline of RWB-S9-E6033-CON, declare the visit, the evidence and the rule as three consumed rows with fakes and placeholders, declare no evidence column, no visit table, no result enumeration and no partner role enumeration, declare EV-21 with one direction and the conflict recorded, declare no new operation, Schedule or job, and hold the media types, the result vocabulary, the field-app interface, the 409 text and the requirement row open.
